title: Samurai Bunny Showdown
description: A white rabbit samurai in ornate orange and blue armor stands centrally holding two katanas in a defensive stance on a cracked cobblestone street. He is surrounded by four human figures: a kneeling woman in a pink and black striped corset, a bald man with a crowbar, a woman with pink hair mid-run, and a tall blonde woman in a black gown and crown holding a fan.
prompt: A fierce white rabbit samurai wearing detailed orange and blue samurai armor stands in the center of a ruined cobblestone street, dual-wielding katanas in a combat stance. Around him are four aggressive figures: a kneeling goth woman in pink striped corset, a bald punk with crowbar, a running woman with pink hair and weapons, and a tall blonde queen in a black gown and crown holding a decorative fan. Dramatic gothic cathedral with pink and black striped towers in the background, graffiti covered walls, dramatic pink and purple sunset lighting, dust and motion effects, highly detailed digital painting.
